displayName: 埃齐奥·奥迪托雷 Ezio Auditore
description: Unofficial fan-art Ezio Auditore companion inspired by Assassin's Creed II. Simplified costume and original nine-state choreography feature hood checks, a safe low-rail vault, unfurling a city map, map-roll recovery, and agile running. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Ubisoft.
